title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy script-src allows plaintext HTTP origins
description: A policy permits plaintext script origins. A CSP is only as strong as its source list: once http: appears in script-src, the policy authorises whatever the network delivers, so the header no longer constrains script execution for anyone on the path.
applicability: HTML responses that deliver a Content-Security-Policy header.
risk: Script injection through plaintext transport is authorised by policy; MEDIUM severity.
